questions.question: Before Israel crossed the Jordan, what did Moses command the fighting men of Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh to do?

answers.text: Cross over armed ahead of their brothers
Stay behind and guard their new cities
Build a wall along the Jordan River

questions.question: Why did Moses tell Joshua not to be afraid of the kingdoms he was about to enter?

answers.text: The LORD Himself would fight for him
Israel's army was far bigger than theirs

questions.question: After seeing God's mighty works, what did Moses plead with the LORD to let him do?

answers.text: Cross over and see the good land
Defeat one more king in battle
See the face of the LORD

questions.question: The LORD told Moses that he would not cross the Jordan River into the land. True or false?
